## Fresh flowers delivered to 100 countries

We've been delivering online flowers since 2004 and over the years, we've become the go-to online
florist for millions of customers around the world. We know that behind every bouquet delivery
there's an emotional message being expressed. A personal message that is shared despite great
distances between people. Making smiles travel around the world is our mission!

[Discover our passion][255]

## Flowers that make memories

There is a bouquet for every occasion and we are here to help you find the one to express just the
right sentiment. Share a dozen red roses to share a passionate smile, a bouquet of white lilies to
say "thanks" or a colourful bouquet of gerberas to say "Happy Birthday". It does not matter whether
you try one of our suggestions or let your instincts lead you to the perfect bouquet. Sending
flowers is a sure-fire way to share the most-heartfelt emotion.

[Send Flowers][256]

## Do you want to surprise with a flower delivery to someone's door?

[Select your bouquet >][257]

# Home

## When science meets innovation beautiful things grow

# Welcome to FloraLife

For 85 years and counting, FloraLife has been the flower care experts and worldwide leader in
postharvest flower care and handling. Since the invention of the first flower food in 1938, we’ve
continued to partner with our clients to address specific quality concerns and create a line of
floral care products formulated specifically to feed, hydrate, nourish and protect at every level of
the distribution chain. As a globally positioned company, we are proud to offer our expertise,
consultation and education to anyone in the floral industry seeking the knowledge and tools
necessary to provide the freshest and longest lasting flowers to their customers.

FloraLife is a division of Smithers-Oasis Company, a globally positioned company dedicated to the
innovation and needs of the floral industry worldwide. As a true one-stop shop, we aim to provide
the products, services and continued education that enables our customers to maximize the longevity
of their floral products and designs.

**We help our customers exceed their consumers’ expectations, providing positive experiences that
elevate the industry and generate repeat purchases.**

[Floralife is for Optimal flower care]
Find Out More Expand

Farm to vase, as your total care solution provider for cut flowers, FloraLife products are specially
formulated to maximize the vase life of your fresh cut flowers. Our continued goal in every product
that we engineer and produce is to help our customers shrink the shrink and ensure the best cut
flower experience for consumers.

At every point of the distribution chain, we are there to offer innovation, consultation and a wide
range of products that keep flowers properly hydrated, nourished and treated through the
postharvest, storage, transportation, display and consumer phases.

[Floralife Optimal Flower Care]
[Innovating]
[Floralife is for Innovating]
Find Out More Expand

At Smithers-Oasis, our proud tradition of innovation for the floral industry was established in 1938
with the invention of the first FloraLife® Flower Food, followed by the invention of OASIS® branded
floral foam in 1954. Over the years we’ve had many groundbreaking innovations that have changed our
beloved industry forever. From our inception, we’ve remained resolute in our pursuit of excellence.

We pride ourselves in having one of the largest research and development staff solely dedicated to
the science and technology of fresh cut flowers. Our highly trained chemists and on-staff
horticulturists continuously test and evaluate our products as well as develop new products based on
the emerging needs of the industry. Our team's dedication and commitment are to ensure that our
customers receive the best products available, anywhere.

We strive to address the specific needs of the cut flower industry, offering innovative products and
solutions to satisfy those needs. Our goal is to help our customers provide the freshest, most
attractive, and longest-lasting flowers possible. It is our passion to maximize the consumer's
experience with flowers!

[Floralife is for Sustainable living]
Find Out More Expand

It has never been as important as it is today to track and reduce our footprint on the planet.
Growing, processing and distributing flowers use many resources to guarantee that high quality,
beautiful fresh cut flowers reach the hands of consumers. At FloraLife, we have focused our
sustainability plan on 5 key commitments to reduce our impact on the planet and help all our
partners, big and small, reduce theirs too. The 5 commitments are climate change, water stewardship,
product portfolio, sustainable packaging and stakeholder awareness.

Floral industry waste impacts almost all areas of sustainability. Putting measures in place to
reduce it should be top of mind. Every stem requires land to grow, water to hydrate, products to
treat, energy to cool, packaging to protect, fuel to ship and lots of labor. When a flower does not
make it to the end consumer, it is not only the flower that is wasted. It is also all the resources
that went into growing, packaging, protecting and shipping it through the long chain. Having the
proper flower care and handling protocols in place not only ensures that you put top quality flowers
in the hands of consumers, but it also can significantly reduce waste which in turn reduces your
footprint on the planet.

Together, we can make a bigger difference!

**[Learn more about our Sustainable Practices][41]**

[Zero waste, plastic free concept. Disposable paper cups on beige background top view. Eco
sustainable living]
[Graduation Student Flowers_DT_640X427]
[Floralife is for Educating]
Find Out More Expand

At FloraLife, we share our expert cut flower knowledge, products, and services to help educate every
level of our industry. As the flower care experts, we are passionate about the pursuit of education
and what it can mean for the success of the entire industry. Our team is globally positioned and
accessible for your educational needs. Our experts can be on-site to conduct care and handling,
proper practices and protocols, as well as merchandising training. We present monthly webinars,
publish research papers and educational articles, and speak at industry events.

We are always searching for new and better ways to reach all levels of the flower community to
further educate and promote the business of fresh cut flowers. One of the education innovation we
pride ourselves in is the Flower Food for Thought® program… because an educated consumer is a repeat
purchaser, and a growing educated consumer base means a growing floral industry!

[Floralife is for Servicing the industry]
Find Out More Expand

FloraLife representatives are your complete resource for all things related to the care and handling
of fresh cut flowers.  Each representative is hand-selected for their experience, expertise, and
passion for the floral industry.  Once they become part of the FloraLife family, our Flower Experts
receive additional, extensive education and training to ensure they are ready and able to assist you
with your complete cut flower needs:
* Fresh cut flower care and handling guidance and seminars.
* Product training at every level of the retail and distribution chain.
* Flower testing and benchmarking.
* Advice on the installation and repair of Floralife® Dosing Systems.
* Air and water quality, ethylene and bacteria level testing.
* Guidance to develop marketing programs and collateral.
* Facility troubleshooting and audits to help resolve flower quality issues.
* Development of proper care and handling protocols at every level of the distribution chain.
* Advice on best practices for receiving flowers.
* Quality Assurance personnel training.
* Advice on new research and developments in cut flower care and handling.
* Care and handling training materials (product information sheets, monthly research articles, etc.)
* Full FloraLife laboratory support and the latest technologies in the floral industry.
* Global network with localized teams available to assist.
* Webinars.
* Custom products and packaging.
* Guidance on global sourcing.
* Training and implementation of sustainable practices and measures.

[Servicing the Industry]
[Floralife is for You]
[Floralife is for YOU]
Find Out More Expand

Although we all share the story of flowers, every channel in the floral industry has a different
chapter to write. FloraLife works with customers to analyze their business and become partners in
floriculture, matching their demands, goals and ambitions with the right products and technologies
to best tell their story. Working together, we can help your business remain profitable and
successful, not just through our industry leading floral care products, but also through our
company's specific services and solutions. Let’s start talking about FloraLife and YOU!

[Floralife is for Sustainable living]
Find Out More Expand

It has never been as important as it is today to track and reduce our footprint on the planet.
Growing, processing and distributing flowers use many resources to guarantee that high quality,
beautiful fresh cut flowers reach the hands of consumers. At FloraLife, we have focused our
sustainability plan on 5 key commitments to reduce our impact on the planet and help all our
partners, big and small, reduce theirs too. The 5 commitments are climate change, water stewardship,
product portfolio, sustainable packaging and stakeholder awareness.

Floral industry waste impacts almost all areas of sustainability. Putting measures in place to
reduce it should be top of mind. Every stem requires land to grow, water to hydrate, products to
treat, energy to cool, packaging to protect, fuel to ship and lots of labor. When a flower does not
make it to the end consumer, it is not only the flower that is wasted. It is also all the resources
that went into growing, packaging, protecting and shipping it through the long chain. Having the
proper flower care and handling protocols in place not only ensures that you put top quality flowers
in the hands of consumers, but it also can significantly reduce waste which in turn reduces your
footprint on the planet.

Together, we can make a bigger difference!

**[Learn more about our Sustainable Practices][41]**

[Zero waste, plastic free concept. Disposable paper cups on beige background top view. Eco
sustainable living]
[Graduation Student Flowers_DT_640X427]
[Floralife is for Educating]
Find Out More Expand

At FloraLife, we share our expert cut flower knowledge, products, and services to help educate every
level of our industry. As the flower care experts, we are passionate about the pursuit of education
and what it can mean for the success of the entire industry. Our team is globally positioned and
accessible for your educational needs. Our experts can be on-site to conduct care and handling,
proper practices and protocols, as well as merchandising training. We present monthly webinars,
publish research papers and educational articles, and speak at industry events.

We are always searching for new and better ways to reach all levels of the flower community to
further educate and promote the business of fresh cut flowers. One of the education innovation we
pride ourselves in is the Flower Food for Thought® program… because an educated consumer is a repeat
purchaser, and a growing educated consumer base means a growing floral industry!

[Floralife is for Servicing the industry]
Find Out More Expand

FloraLife representatives are your complete resource for all things related to the care and handling
of fresh cut flowers.  Each representative is hand-selected for their experience, expertise, and
passion for the floral industry.  Once they become part of the FloraLife family, our Flower Experts
receive additional, extensive education and training to ensure they are ready and able to assist you
with your complete cut flower needs:
* Fresh cut flower care and handling guidance and seminars.
* Product training at every level of the retail and distribution chain.
* Flower testing and benchmarking.
* Advice on the installation and repair of Floralife® Dosing Systems.
* Air and water quality, ethylene and bacteria level testing.
* Guidance to develop marketing programs and collateral.
* Facility troubleshooting and audits to help resolve flower quality issues.
* Development of proper care and handling protocols at every level of the distribution chain.
* Advice on best practices for receiving flowers.
* Quality Assurance personnel training.
* Advice on new research and developments in cut flower care and handling.
* Care and handling training materials (product information sheets, monthly research articles, etc.)
* Full FloraLife laboratory support and the latest technologies in the floral industry.
* Global network with localized teams available to assist.
* Webinars.
* Custom products and packaging.
* Guidance on global sourcing.
* Training and implementation of sustainable practices and measures.

[Servicing the Industry]
[Floralife is for You]
[Floralife is for YOU]
Find Out More Expand

Although we all share the story of flowers, every channel in the floral industry has a different
chapter to write. FloraLife works with customers to analyze their business and become partners in
floriculture, matching their demands, goals and ambitions with the right products and technologies
to best tell their story. Working together, we can help your business remain profitable and
successful, not just through our industry leading floral care products, but also through our
company's specific services and solutions. Let’s start talking about FloraLife and YOU!

# APM Logistics & Transportation LLC

APM is a transportation, logistics, and warehouse distribution specialist for perishable cargo. We
proudly provide refrigerated long haul, regional, and dedicated deliveries for industries that
including floral, produce, and plants

Feel free to browse our website and contact us should you require further information regarding our
floral distribution services.

[New Account][10]

[apm trucking logo]

All of our refrigerated warehouses at **APM Logistics & Transportation LLC** are managed by seasoned
transportation experts who have extensive knowledge of the floral industry.

We understand the importance of customization and therefore, we are able to tailor scheduling,
receiving, and loading procedures to meet the unique needs of our customers. Our commitment to
excellence is reflected in our high standards for cold chain and humidification status. Each
delivery and shipping door is sealed and air-tight to ensure optimal conditions. We utilize
top-quality cooling and humidifying equipment, and our loads are continuously monitored to maintain
the best possible environment for every product under our care.

# APM Logistics & Transportation LLC

APM is a transportation, logistics, and warehouse distribution specialist for perishable cargo. We
proudly provide refrigerated long haul, regional, and dedicated deliveries for industries that
including floral, produce, and plants

Feel free to browse our website and contact us should you require further information regarding our
floral distribution services.

[New Account][10]

[apm trucking logo]

All of our refrigerated warehouses at **APM Logistics & Transportation LLC** are managed by seasoned
transportation experts who have extensive knowledge of the floral industry.

We understand the importance of customization and therefore, we are able to tailor scheduling,
receiving, and loading procedures to meet the unique needs of our customers. Our commitment to
excellence is reflected in our high standards for cold chain and humidification status. Each
delivery and shipping door is sealed and air-tight to ensure optimal conditions. We utilize
top-quality cooling and humidifying equipment, and our loads are continuously monitored to maintain
the best possible environment for every product under our care.

## Apparel Collection

But we're not just about flowers! Our apparel collection is designed to keep you looking stylish and
on-trend. We curate a range of clothing and accessories that combine comfort, quality, and a touch
of flair. Whether you're searching for a statement piece or an everyday essential, you'll find
something to suit your style in our carefully selected inventory.

[ Shop Now ][52]

## Special Occasion Florals

At Bundles & Brand, we take pride in our Event Floral expertise. From stunning wedding bouquets to
heartfelt funeral arrangements, captivating business party centerpieces to charming shower
decorations, we create floral masterpieces that will leave a lasting impression on your guests. Our
team of talented florists carefully handpick the freshest blooms to ensure that every arrangement is
a work of art. We understand that these occasions hold great significance in your life, and we're
here to help you make them truly memorable.

[ Services ][53]

## Grown Locally

We know how important it is to support local businesses, which is why we strive to source our
flowers and apparel from nearby growers and designers. This ensures that you not only receive the
best products but also contribute to the growth and sustainability of our community.

## About Bundles & Brand

Welcome to Bundles & Brand, your one-stop shop for fresh flowers and trendy apparel! We're a
small-town business catering to flower enthusiasts and fashion lovers alike. Whether you're planning
a special event or simply looking to treat yourself, we've got you covered with our unique selection
and personalized service.

At Bundles & Brand, we believe that shopping should be a delightful experience from start to finish.
Our friendly and knowledgeable staff is always ready to assist you, offering personalized
recommendations and helpful advice. We're here to listen to your needs and help you find the perfect
floral arrangement or fashion item that fits your vision and budget.

So why wait? Explore our online store now and discover the perfect bundle for yourself or a loved
one. Bundles & Brand is your trusted destination for fresh flowers, fashion-forward apparel, and
exceptional service. Let us help you create memorable moments with our exquisite Event Floral
arrangements and stylish clothing options. Shop with us today and experience the difference!

[About Us][54]

## Located at The Collective

We are proud to share a space with M. Mongan Décor at The Collective. Shop our collection at our
brick-and-mortar store, The Collective, located at 1000 Pines Rd. Oregon, IL 61061.

**Color your world**

The Netherlands is the world's largest player in the floriculture industry. We owe this position to
companies that continuously innovate. Dekker Chrysanten is one of them. Internationally, we are one
of the largest breeders and propagators of chrysanthemums. By continuously renewing our range with
attractive varieties, we maintain consumer focus on chrysanthemums. We do this not only in our own
country, but globally through distributors and our own offices in Colombia, Kenya, and Vietnam. With
production locations in Hensbroek and Tanzania, we supply customers in large parts of the world with
chrysanthemum cuttings.

[Read more about our innovative approach.][80]

## Product range

### Disbud

Decorative and stylish

### Spray

The ultimate chrysanthemum

### Santini

The basis for bouquets

### Madiba®

A colourful explosion of small flowers

### Product range

Our complete product range in all segments

## These are our brands that really add value

A new and innovative chrysanthemum variety. A friendly appearance with 30 to 40 flowers per stem.

Resq: the colorful solution. This color family is the chrysanthemum of the future!

Colour your world.

**Color your world**

The Netherlands is the world's largest player in the floriculture industry. We owe this position to
companies that continuously innovate. Dekker Chrysanten is one of them. Internationally, we are one
of the largest breeders and propagators of chrysanthemums. By continuously renewing our range with
attractive varieties, we maintain consumer focus on chrysanthemums. We do this not only in our own
country, but globally through distributors and our own offices in Colombia, Kenya, and Vietnam. With
production locations in Hensbroek and Tanzania, we supply customers in large parts of the world with
chrysanthemum cuttings.

# We Aspire To Be Our Customers’
# Most Valuable Supplier

### Your Trusted Wholesale Floral Partner

For more than 65 years, DVFlora has supplied professional retail florists and event designers with
premium fresh-cut flowers, botanicals and floral hardgoods sourced from leading growers and
suppliers around the world. Our strategically located distribution network, including our
headquarters in Sewell, New Jersey, our Southeast hub in Augusta, Georgia, [Marvin’s Wholesale
Florist][37] serving the Indianapolis market, and [Rokay Flowers][38] serving Michigan, provides
dependable next-day service, exceptional product availability, and the flexibility to order by the
bunch, piece, or case. Backed by knowledgeable floral professionals and a commitment to your
success, we’re here to help your business succeed.

## Our Floral & Hardgood Products


### Flowers

From everyday staples to premium specialty blooms, DVFlora offers one of the industry’s largest
selections of fresh-cut flowers sourced from leading growers around the world. Our commitment to
cold-chain management and expert product handling helps ensure every stem arrives with the
freshness, quality, and vase life your customers expect.


### Greens

Complete every arrangement with an extensive selection of fresh-cut greens, foliage, and seasonal
evergreens. Sourced from trusted growers across the globe, our inventory includes everyday
essentials, specialty varieties, and over 100 holiday evergreen selections to help you create
beautiful designs throughout the year.


### Floral Hardgoods

Everything you need to bring your designs to life, all in one place. From containers, ribbon, foam,
wire, and tools to seasonal décor and everyday essentials, our comprehensive selection of floral
hardgoods makes it easy to shop for everything your business needs with a single order.


### Botanicals

Bring lasting beauty to your customers with a vibrant selection of foliage and blooming plants. With
fresh shipments arriving throughout the week, our botanicals are carefully selected for quality,
freshness, and performance, giving you dependable availability for everyday sales, gifts, decor, and
special events.

### Your Trusted Wholesale Floral Partner

For more than 65 years, DVFlora has supplied professional retail florists and event designers with
premium fresh-cut flowers, botanicals and floral hardgoods sourced from leading growers and
suppliers around the world. Our strategically located distribution network, including our
headquarters in Sewell, New Jersey, our Southeast hub in Augusta, Georgia, [Marvin’s Wholesale
Florist][37] serving the Indianapolis market, and [Rokay Flowers][38] serving Michigan, provides
dependable next-day service, exceptional product availability, and the flexibility to order by the
bunch, piece, or case. Backed by knowledgeable floral professionals and a commitment to your
success, we’re here to help your business succeed.

## Our Floral & Hardgood Products


### Flowers

From everyday staples to premium specialty blooms, DVFlora offers one of the industry’s largest
selections of fresh-cut flowers sourced from leading growers around the world. Our commitment to
cold-chain management and expert product handling helps ensure every stem arrives with the
freshness, quality, and vase life your customers expect.


### Greens

Complete every arrangement with an extensive selection of fresh-cut greens, foliage, and seasonal
evergreens. Sourced from trusted growers across the globe, our inventory includes everyday
essentials, specialty varieties, and over 100 holiday evergreen selections to help you create
beautiful designs throughout the year.


### Floral Hardgoods

Everything you need to bring your designs to life, all in one place. From containers, ribbon, foam,
wire, and tools to seasonal décor and everyday essentials, our comprehensive selection of floral
hardgoods makes it easy to shop for everything your business needs with a single order.


### Botanicals

Bring lasting beauty to your customers with a vibrant selection of foliage and blooming plants. With
fresh shipments arriving throughout the week, our botanicals are carefully selected for quality,
freshness, and performance, giving you dependable availability for everyday sales, gifts, decor, and
special events.

# India's Leading Brand for Flowers, Cakes, Plants & Gifts

We know that adapting to this New Normal can be really triggering for some of us but we are in this
together and will definitely come out stronger. Keeping in touch with your loved ones is really
important these days and one of the best ways of doing that is sending a bunch of Fresh and Vibrant
Flowers with a special note.

## **Now the question is how sending flowers can bring happiness?**

Imagine that you are having one of those days when nothing goes right and suddenly you hear the
doorbell. On the other side of the door is a human standing with a bunch of vibrant flowers
specially handpicked for you sent by one of your dear friends. Isn't it just the best surprise?? The
smile on your face after holding those flowers is what the world needs right now!! A little more
happiness and a little less loneliness. After all its social distancing, not social isolation. Let
your loved ones know how much you care about them and how badly you miss their wide smile by sending
them a virtual hug wrapped in some long-stem freshly picked flowers. We at Flaberry aspire to be
your partners in crime in this as your wish is our command and have the widest collection of Roses,
Carnations, Lilies, Tulips, Orchids and Cakes to help you order online the best flower bouquets and
gifts.

## **Why Flaberry?**

### **Our ingenious process of procurement**

Flaberry is the only company in India that procures flowers straight from the farm and deliver to
your home with the utmost safety following a strong Farm to Table Model.

Let’s dig deep and understand the difference between traditional process and our process and how are
we different.

The traditional process begins with the farm where the flowers are procured. This is followed by the
auction centre in the vicinity of farms. Here, the flowers are auctioned, after which they reach the
distributors in the city of the auction centre. This is followed by the flower mandi in different
cities where they are sold to the flower retailers.

Once the flower retailers purchase them, they are provided to potential customers. Ultimately, this
process consumes ample time and as you can rightly imagine the time-consuming process extracts the
freshness from the flowers and is heavy on your pocket too!

But at Flaberry, the flowers are hand-picked from the farms and sent straight to the Flaberry
warehouse where we arrange them uniquely for our customers. Eventually, these fresh flowers are
delivered to the customers instantly to make them bloom with joy. This is how we manage to stand out
like no other.

### **Flowers that promise durability**

“*Flowers that live long, foster joy for longer*.” Since flowers are a symbol of positivity,
happiness and good vibes, we want to make sure that nothing comes in between that. However, when
flowers lose this charm, the whole meaning of owning them is rendered in vain.

We at Flaberry believe in the efficacy of these statements and that is what drives us to deliver
flowers that serve durability. By scrapping out the traditional system of procuring flowers, we aim
at a rapid procurement process that increases the shelf life of the exotic flowers we offer. At
every level of procurement, our team of professional florists draw enhanced focus on the freshness
of flowers to keep them live longer. For every flower, we use a different method of keeping their
freshness intact. The improved process of obtaining these flowers within two to three days of
hand-picking promises a 100% longer shelf life as compared to what’s available in the market today.

At our warehouses, we have a separate team of caretakers who are responsible for maintaining the
durability of the flowers. By applying innovative techniques to keep the flowers smiling, we succeed
in increasing their shelf life for you. This is how all our clients are presented with the most
beautiful fresh flowers they have ever seen. As a result, anyone who opts for flowers at our stop is
sure to avail of the best flowers they can find anywhere else.

### **We let the flowers do the talking**


“*Flowers can convey a thousand words that the heart cannot confess*.” As we value this thought, we
at Flaberry make sure to avail the most envious collection of flower arrangements for you. Hence,
Flaberry owns its warehouses in numerous major cities across India with a colossal team of experts.

Each Flaberry warehouse consists of a highly diligent team of experts who brainstorm towards
creating the most innovative flower arrangements for you. Timely conferences are held to strategize
the diverse ways of creating flower arrangements that leave the beholder awe-struck, in true sense,
we spend hours on end in attempting to make your face light up. The flowers arranged artistically
are delivered to your doorstep from our own fleet of Delivery Boys armed with all necessary Covid 19
precautions.

In the places where we don’t have our own warehouse presence we have partnered with the best
merchant in the local city providing them with all the collaterals, guidelines and knowhow to make
the best arrangements for you because you and your loved one deserve the best! Right now, our team
consists of over 2500 leading merchants across India who enables us to come to your rescue for
giving fresh flowers daily.

### **The best-ever designer arrangements for you**

At Flaberry, we aim at crafting exclusive flower arrangements that mesmerize the beholder like never
before. Our intricate designs, innovative strategies and exotic flower décor make us who we are
today. To make this vision turn into reality, we collaborate with the best designers across the
globe who launch ecstatic designs during different seasons for you. Recently, our team of expert
professionals has collaborated with the famous Italian designer, Vittoria Moroni who helps us to
launch out-of-the-box flower collections each season for you.

The limited-edition collection from his designs is sure to spread vibrance and positivity everywhere
you go. The signature collection comes in a diverse range of cyan boxes that contain exotic flowers
from all over the globe. Each flower arrangement comes with a complimentary gift card where you can
pen down your thoughts for those who you want to gift this product.

Our collaboration with this excellent designer has always enabled us to make our clients buzz with
excitement. The exclusive flower arrangements that we design together are delivered to them at hand
down prices that are rare to find anywhere else. This is what makes all our customers come back for
more. From Valentine’s Day, birthday, anniversaries to corporate events, we design flower
arrangements for all occasions. Name it and, we have it for you!

# India's Leading Brand for Flowers, Cakes, Plants & Gifts

We know that adapting to this New Normal can be really triggering for some of us but we are in this
together and will definitely come out stronger. Keeping in touch with your loved ones is really
important these days and one of the best ways of doing that is sending a bunch of Fresh and Vibrant
Flowers with a special note.

## **Now the question is how sending flowers can bring happiness?**

Imagine that you are having one of those days when nothing goes right and suddenly you hear the
doorbell. On the other side of the door is a human standing with a bunch of vibrant flowers
specially handpicked for you sent by one of your dear friends. Isn't it just the best surprise?? The
smile on your face after holding those flowers is what the world needs right now!! A little more
happiness and a little less loneliness. After all its social distancing, not social isolation. Let
your loved ones know how much you care about them and how badly you miss their wide smile by sending
them a virtual hug wrapped in some long-stem freshly picked flowers. We at Flaberry aspire to be
your partners in crime in this as your wish is our command and have the widest collection of Roses,
Carnations, Lilies, Tulips, Orchids and Cakes to help you order online the best flower bouquets and
gifts.

## **Why Flaberry?**

### **Our ingenious process of procurement**

Flaberry is the only company in India that procures flowers straight from the farm and deliver to
your home with the utmost safety following a strong Farm to Table Model.

Let’s dig deep and understand the difference between traditional process and our process and how are
we different.

The traditional process begins with the farm where the flowers are procured. This is followed by the
auction centre in the vicinity of farms. Here, the flowers are auctioned, after which they reach the
distributors in the city of the auction centre. This is followed by the flower mandi in different
cities where they are sold to the flower retailers.

Once the flower retailers purchase them, they are provided to potential customers. Ultimately, this
process consumes ample time and as you can rightly imagine the time-consuming process extracts the
freshness from the flowers and is heavy on your pocket too!

But at Flaberry, the flowers are hand-picked from the farms and sent straight to the Flaberry
warehouse where we arrange them uniquely for our customers. Eventually, these fresh flowers are
delivered to the customers instantly to make them bloom with joy. This is how we manage to stand out
like no other.

### **Flowers that promise durability**

“*Flowers that live long, foster joy for longer*.” Since flowers are a symbol of positivity,
happiness and good vibes, we want to make sure that nothing comes in between that. However, when
flowers lose this charm, the whole meaning of owning them is rendered in vain.

We at Flaberry believe in the efficacy of these statements and that is what drives us to deliver
flowers that serve durability. By scrapping out the traditional system of procuring flowers, we aim
at a rapid procurement process that increases the shelf life of the exotic flowers we offer. At
every level of procurement, our team of professional florists draw enhanced focus on the freshness
of flowers to keep them live longer. For every flower, we use a different method of keeping their
freshness intact. The improved process of obtaining these flowers within two to three days of
hand-picking promises a 100% longer shelf life as compared to what’s available in the market today.

At our warehouses, we have a separate team of caretakers who are responsible for maintaining the
durability of the flowers. By applying innovative techniques to keep the flowers smiling, we succeed
in increasing their shelf life for you. This is how all our clients are presented with the most
beautiful fresh flowers they have ever seen. As a result, anyone who opts for flowers at our stop is
sure to avail of the best flowers they can find anywhere else.

### **We let the flowers do the talking**


“*Flowers can convey a thousand words that the heart cannot confess*.” As we value this thought, we
at Flaberry make sure to avail the most envious collection of flower arrangements for you. Hence,
Flaberry owns its warehouses in numerous major cities across India with a colossal team of experts.

Each Flaberry warehouse consists of a highly diligent team of experts who brainstorm towards
creating the most innovative flower arrangements for you. Timely conferences are held to strategize
the diverse ways of creating flower arrangements that leave the beholder awe-struck, in true sense,
we spend hours on end in attempting to make your face light up. The flowers arranged artistically
are delivered to your doorstep from our own fleet of Delivery Boys armed with all necessary Covid 19
precautions.

In the places where we don’t have our own warehouse presence we have partnered with the best
merchant in the local city providing them with all the collaterals, guidelines and knowhow to make
the best arrangements for you because you and your loved one deserve the best! Right now, our team
consists of over 2500 leading merchants across India who enables us to come to your rescue for
giving fresh flowers daily.

### **The best-ever designer arrangements for you**

At Flaberry, we aim at crafting exclusive flower arrangements that mesmerize the beholder like never
before. Our intricate designs, innovative strategies and exotic flower décor make us who we are
today. To make this vision turn into reality, we collaborate with the best designers across the
globe who launch ecstatic designs during different seasons for you. Recently, our team of expert
professionals has collaborated with the famous Italian designer, Vittoria Moroni who helps us to
launch out-of-the-box flower collections each season for you.

The limited-edition collection from his designs is sure to spread vibrance and positivity everywhere
you go. The signature collection comes in a diverse range of cyan boxes that contain exotic flowers
from all over the globe. Each flower arrangement comes with a complimentary gift card where you can
pen down your thoughts for those who you want to gift this product.

Our collaboration with this excellent designer has always enabled us to make our clients buzz with
excitement. The exclusive flower arrangements that we design together are delivered to them at hand
down prices that are rare to find anywhere else. This is what makes all our customers come back for
more. From Valentine’s Day, birthday, anniversaries to corporate events, we design flower
arrangements for all occasions. Name it and, we have it for you!

# Weddings Bloom Here


##### Unforgettable Floral Designs from Oakland, Florida

[ Inquire Today ][17]

## Wedding & Event FLORAL

We take great pride in crafting floral designs that are not only creative but deeply thoughtful,
reflecting your unique story and personality. With over 300 weddings completed — ranging from
intimate gatherings to grand celebrations — we are honored to have consistently earned 5-star
reviews on Google.
[Farm Nine Weddings Icon]

#### Wedding Floral Services

Our Wedding Floral Services are custom tailored to you for beautiful weddings.

[ Wedding Floral Services ][18]
[Farm Nine Events Icon]

#### Event Floral Services

We make event floral arrangements easy with our Event Floral Services.

[ Event Floral Services ][19]

### Featured In

[ [People Magazine Logo] ][20]
[ [Spectrum News 13 Logo] ][21]
[ [The Local Magazine Winter Garden Logo] ][22]
[ [West Orange Observer Logo] ][23]
[ [100 Layer Cake Logo] ][24]

## The Farm Nine Difference

Farm Nine has completed well over 300 weddings and we recognize it is one of the most important
stories in a couple’s life. We feel incredibly honored and grateful to be a part of this moment in
your life and your wedding day is a reflection of who you are and what you love.

We take extreme care in designing your flowers with creativity, love, and a lot of thought as to who
you are and what your story is.

[ See Our Floral Services ][25]

### Micaela M.

###### Winter Garden Wedding Testimonial

“We are SO elated that we hired Farm Nine to be our florist for our wedding. Everything was
absolutely spectacular and they executed our vision flawlessly from the centerpieces to the
bouquets. They even went out of their way to find blue spruce trees not native to Florida that were
gorgeous! We couldn’t recommend Farm Nine more.”

Google Testimonial

## The Farm Nine Story

My dream became a reality when my husband, Flor, and I purchased 13 acres and built our farmhouse in
2017. Flor and I, along with our 7 kids, moved in and settled into farm life. We have turkeys,
goats, chickens, donkeys, pigs and milking cows!

But where my childhood dreams really came true was in the rows of blossoming, unique plants that
produce the most beautiful blooms full of fragrance and texture. I am in my element when I am in the
potting shed, designing and arranging breathtaking arrangements of flowers that I picked just one
hundred feet away. It was here that Farm Nine was founded.

# Produzione e commercio di fiori e piante

Siamo una cooperativa di produttori: ogni giorno lavoriamo insieme per portare piante, fiori e
prodotti per l’agricoltura dove servono, con qualità, esperienza e fiducia reciproca.
[SCOPRI la nostra storia][103]
[

## Produzione fiori e piante

][105]

## Chi siamo

Siamo più di un’azienda: **siamo 230 soci e 140 collaboratori** uniti dallo stesso obiettivo —
coltivare valore, **insieme**.

Ci occupiamo di **produzione e commercializzazione di fiori, fogliame reciso e piante in vaso**,
dalla talea al prodotto finito.

Organizziamo la produzione, la trasformazione e la distribuzione di fiori recisi, fogliame e piante
in vaso.

Accanto a questo, offriamo **prodotti e mezzi tecnici per l’agricoltura**, accompagnando chi lavora
la terra con consulenza e supporto tecnico.

[ Il gruppo Flora Toscana ][106]
[ I nostri soci ][107]

## Produzione e grossisti di fiori e piante

Ogni giorno ci prendiamo cura di una **filiera viva**, fatta di persone, stagioni e mani esperte.
Dedichiamo la massima attenzione alla qualità, alla freschezza e alla programmazione, per offrire
**un prodotto costante nel tempo e rispettoso dei ritmi naturali**.

## Chi siamo

Siamo più di un’azienda: **siamo 230 soci e 140 collaboratori** uniti dallo stesso obiettivo —
coltivare valore, **insieme**.

Ci occupiamo di **produzione e commercializzazione di fiori, fogliame reciso e piante in vaso**,
dalla talea al prodotto finito.

Organizziamo la produzione, la trasformazione e la distribuzione di fiori recisi, fogliame e piante
in vaso.

Accanto a questo, offriamo **prodotti e mezzi tecnici per l’agricoltura**, accompagnando chi lavora
la terra con consulenza e supporto tecnico.

Какое ближайшее метро?

который сегодня, как и многие бывшие промышленные площадки в стране наполняется новыми и интересными

чуть выше.

детей.

[What We Do]
What We Do

Florista Philippines is your trusted online flower and gifting partner, dedicated to delivering
smiles across the country. From Metro Manila to Cebu, Davao, Quezon City, Makati, and more—we bring
you beautiful floral arrangements, cakes, chocolates, and curated gift items for every special
occasion. Our journey continues as we expand our reach, products, and services to serve you even
better.

[Flower Shops Across the Country]
Fresh Flowers from Shops Across the Philippines

We collaborate with skilled florists and local flower shops across the Philippines to ensure every
bouquet is crafted with love and expertise. Whether it's a birthday, anniversary, or a “just
because” surprise, our flowers come fresh from talented hands with years of experience in floral
design. At Florista Philippines, we believe in celebrating life with only the finest blooms and
thoughtful gifts for your loved ones.

[Our Services]
Our Promises & Services

At Florista Philippines, we’re committed to making every moment special. Our services include
same-day flower delivery, premium gift bundles, personalized items, and signature floral
arrangements. Whether you’re sending love from afar or planning a surprise gift, our team is here to
make it seamless, special, and unforgettable—because every gesture matters.

Get Exclusive Flower Deals

Sign up to receive special offers and new collection updates

Sign Up

## Send Fresh Flowers Across the Philippines with Florista.ph

Looking for a flower shop near you that delivers beauty and joy? Florista.ph offers a seamless
online experience for sending fresh flowers anywhere in the Philippines. From the vibrant city
streets of [Manila][147] to the serene homes in [Tagaytay][148] or [Baguio][149], we deliver
happiness wrapped in petals. Whether you're in [Cebu City][150], [Quezon City][151], you can trust
us to handcraft and send the perfect bouquet — be it for birthdays, anniversaries, or “just because”
moments. Choose from our collection of tulip bouquets, rose flower bouquets, sunflower bouquets, or
funeral flowers designed with utmost care and compassion.

## Flower Delivery Philippines – Florista.ph

Florista.ph is more than just a flower shop — it’s your partner in turning every moment into a
memory. Whether you're searching “flower shop near me” or planning to surprise someone with a
bouquet of carnations or tulip flower bouquets, we’ve got your back. From Metro Manila to Bulacan,
Laguna, our same-day delivery service ensures your flowers arrive fresh and right on time. Explore
our range of [flower bouquets][152] featuring white flowers, gerbera, chrysanthemums, orchids, and
lilies for every kind of celebration.

## Same-Day Flower Delivery – Fresh, Fast, and Affordable

Last-minute surprise? No worries. With our same-day flower delivery service available across
[Antipolo][153], Bacoor, Batangas, [Makati][154], and [Pasig][155], we guarantee your order gets
delivered swiftly without compromising quality. Whether you're sending birthday flowers, a [tulip
flower bouquet][156], or a [sympathy bouquet][157], our efficient service ensures your heartfelt
gift reaches on time. Just place your order before 7 PM and we’ll take care of the rest — because we
know how precious each moment is.

## Explore a Wide Selection of Flower Bouquets Online

With an extensive collection of stunning arrangements, Florista.ph offers everything from simple to
luxurious. Find beautiful flowers like pink roses, [blue flowers][158], or [purple flowers][159]
styled in vases, baskets, and modern flower boxes. From classic red rose bouquets to vibrant
combinations featuring pink carnations and hydrangea, our flower store has something for every
taste. You’ll also find [birthday flowers][160] paired with chocolates, teddy bears, or even a
chocolate cake to complete the gesture.

## Delivering to Every Major City and Province in the Philippines

Whether you want to send a rose bouquet to Marikina, a tulip bouquet to Cavite, or a flower box to
Laguna, our wide delivery network has you covered. Florista.ph delivers to key locations across the
country including [Muntinlupa][161], Mandaluyong, Caloocan, Taguig City, and even [Rizal][162]
province. From the heart of Makati’s business district to the peaceful neighborhoods of Bulacan and
Pampanga, our flowers find their way to your loved ones wherever they are.

## Thoughtful Flower Combos: Cake, Teddy Bears & Chocolates

Sometimes a flower bouquet alone just isn’t enough. That’s why we offer amazing combos featuring
birthday cakes, Ferrero Rocher, and adorable teddy bears. Choose from chocolate cake combos for
birthdays, pink flower and teddy bear gifts for anniversaries, or our special “[flowers and
chocolate][163]” surprise box for Valentine’s Day. Whether you're celebrating with a red velvet cake
or sending birthday cake for girls or boys, our curated combos create moments that are truly
unforgettable.

## Flower Boxes and Flower Vases That Speak Elegance

Upgrade your floral gesture with our chic flower boxes or elegant flower vases. From round pink rose
boxes to heart-shaped arrangements, these designs are perfect for anniversaries, apologies, or
luxury gifting. Send a pink rose bouquet in a vase to your loved one in [Davao City][164] or a vase
of [white flowers][165] to a friend in Pasig — each piece is a work of art that carries your
emotions beautifully.

## Guaranteed Fresh Flowers for Every Occasion

Our flowers are sourced directly from trusted farms, ensuring maximum freshness and longevity.
Whether it’s a birthday bouquet of carnations, sympathy funeral flowers, or a stargazer flower
arrangement, we make sure each bloom radiates life and love. If you're looking for long-lasting
beauty in every petal, trust our experienced florist team to hand-tie every arrangement with passion
and care.

## Celebrate Life’s Special Moments with Florista.ph

From romantic rose bouquets to cheerful sunflower bouquets, every product we offer is made to
enhance life’s precious events. Whether it’s a [bridal bouquet for a wedding][166] in Cebu City, a
sympathy flower delivery in Bacoor, or a surprise tulip bouquet in [Bago][167], Florista.ph delivers
beyond expectations. We even cater to seasonal moments with flower and cake combos for Mother’s Day,
Valentine’s, and more.

[What We Do]
What We Do

Florista Philippines is your trusted online flower and gifting partner, dedicated to delivering
smiles across the country. From Metro Manila to Cebu, Davao, Quezon City, Makati, and more—we bring
you beautiful floral arrangements, cakes, chocolates, and curated gift items for every special
occasion. Our journey continues as we expand our reach, products, and services to serve you even
better.

[Flower Shops Across the Country]
Fresh Flowers from Shops Across the Philippines

We collaborate with skilled florists and local flower shops across the Philippines to ensure every
bouquet is crafted with love and expertise. Whether it's a birthday, anniversary, or a “just
because” surprise, our flowers come fresh from talented hands with years of experience in floral
design. At Florista Philippines, we believe in celebrating life with only the finest blooms and
thoughtful gifts for your loved ones.

[Our Services]
Our Promises & Services

At Florista Philippines, we’re committed to making every moment special. Our services include
same-day flower delivery, premium gift bundles, personalized items, and signature floral
arrangements. Whether you’re sending love from afar or planning a surprise gift, our team is here to
make it seamless, special, and unforgettable—because every gesture matters.

Get Exclusive Flower Deals

Sign up to receive special offers and new collection updates

## Send Fresh Flowers Across the Philippines with Florista.ph

Looking for a flower shop near you that delivers beauty and joy? Florista.ph offers a seamless
online experience for sending fresh flowers anywhere in the Philippines. From the vibrant city
streets of [Manila][147] to the serene homes in [Tagaytay][148] or [Baguio][149], we deliver
happiness wrapped in petals. Whether you're in [Cebu City][150], [Quezon City][151], you can trust
us to handcraft and send the perfect bouquet — be it for birthdays, anniversaries, or “just because”
moments. Choose from our collection of tulip bouquets, rose flower bouquets, sunflower bouquets, or
funeral flowers designed with utmost care and compassion.

## Flower Delivery Philippines – Florista.ph

Florista.ph is more than just a flower shop — it’s your partner in turning every moment into a
memory. Whether you're searching “flower shop near me” or planning to surprise someone with a
bouquet of carnations or tulip flower bouquets, we’ve got your back. From Metro Manila to Bulacan,
Laguna, our same-day delivery service ensures your flowers arrive fresh and right on time. Explore
our range of [flower bouquets][152] featuring white flowers, gerbera, chrysanthemums, orchids, and
lilies for every kind of celebration.

## Same-Day Flower Delivery – Fresh, Fast, and Affordable

Last-minute surprise? No worries. With our same-day flower delivery service available across
[Antipolo][153], Bacoor, Batangas, [Makati][154], and [Pasig][155], we guarantee your order gets
delivered swiftly without compromising quality. Whether you're sending birthday flowers, a [tulip
flower bouquet][156], or a [sympathy bouquet][157], our efficient service ensures your heartfelt
gift reaches on time. Just place your order before 7 PM and we’ll take care of the rest — because we
know how precious each moment is.

## Explore a Wide Selection of Flower Bouquets Online

With an extensive collection of stunning arrangements, Florista.ph offers everything from simple to
luxurious. Find beautiful flowers like pink roses, [blue flowers][158], or [purple flowers][159]
styled in vases, baskets, and modern flower boxes. From classic red rose bouquets to vibrant
combinations featuring pink carnations and hydrangea, our flower store has something for every
taste. You’ll also find [birthday flowers][160] paired with chocolates, teddy bears, or even a
chocolate cake to complete the gesture.

## Delivering to Every Major City and Province in the Philippines

Whether you want to send a rose bouquet to Marikina, a tulip bouquet to Cavite, or a flower box to
Laguna, our wide delivery network has you covered. Florista.ph delivers to key locations across the
country including [Muntinlupa][161], Mandaluyong, Caloocan, Taguig City, and even [Rizal][162]
province. From the heart of Makati’s business district to the peaceful neighborhoods of Bulacan and
Pampanga, our flowers find their way to your loved ones wherever they are.

## Thoughtful Flower Combos: Cake, Teddy Bears & Chocolates

Sometimes a flower bouquet alone just isn’t enough. That’s why we offer amazing combos featuring
birthday cakes, Ferrero Rocher, and adorable teddy bears. Choose from chocolate cake combos for
birthdays, pink flower and teddy bear gifts for anniversaries, or our special “[flowers and
chocolate][163]” surprise box for Valentine’s Day. Whether you're celebrating with a red velvet cake
or sending birthday cake for girls or boys, our curated combos create moments that are truly
unforgettable.

## Flower Boxes and Flower Vases That Speak Elegance

Upgrade your floral gesture with our chic flower boxes or elegant flower vases. From round pink rose
boxes to heart-shaped arrangements, these designs are perfect for anniversaries, apologies, or
luxury gifting. Send a pink rose bouquet in a vase to your loved one in [Davao City][164] or a vase
of [white flowers][165] to a friend in Pasig — each piece is a work of art that carries your
emotions beautifully.

## Guaranteed Fresh Flowers for Every Occasion

Our flowers are sourced directly from trusted farms, ensuring maximum freshness and longevity.
Whether it’s a birthday bouquet of carnations, sympathy funeral flowers, or a stargazer flower
arrangement, we make sure each bloom radiates life and love. If you're looking for long-lasting
beauty in every petal, trust our experienced florist team to hand-tie every arrangement with passion
and care.

## Celebrate Life’s Special Moments with Florista.ph

From romantic rose bouquets to cheerful sunflower bouquets, every product we offer is made to
enhance life’s precious events. Whether it’s a [bridal bouquet for a wedding][166] in Cebu City, a
sympathy flower delivery in Bacoor, or a surprise tulip bouquet in [Bago][167], Florista.ph delivers
beyond expectations. We even cater to seasonal moments with flower and cake combos for Mother’s Day,
Valentine’s, and more.

[ Smart investment. Big impact. The best workplace [Smart investment. Big impact. The best workplace
transformations aren't always the biggest. Sometimes they're about recognising the value in what's
already there and creating spaces where people genuinely want to be. This refurbishment breathed new
life into an ageing office, transforming it into a contemporary environment that better supports
collaboration, focus and connection. Working within a cost-conscious brief, the design approach
centred on adaptive reuse, retaining and repurposing existing furniture, infrastructure and spatial
assets wherever possible. By building on existing foundations, the project delivered meaningful
change while minimising waste and maximising value. The result is a warm, flexible and future-ready
workplace that proves thoughtful design doesn't always require a complete reinvention to make a
lasting impact. Delivered in collaboration with Project Manager @wallacepm and extending our thanks
to our broader delivery partners @millikenco_anz @nicciwoodagency @shawcontract_australia @covrd.wa
@laminexau @caesarstoneau @perinitiles @instyle_au @wovenimage @castledex_ #iadesignaustralia
#WorkplaceDesign #InteriorDesign #WorkplaceStrategy #AdaptiveReuse #CommercialInteriors
#PerthDesign] ][46]
[ We’re excited to share the completion of a major 5 [We’re excited to share the completion of a
major 5-floor, 10,000m² commercial office fitout in Adelaide’s CBD - shaped by a design narrative
inspired by the River Torrens and its surrounding landscape The design approach translates ecology,
culture, and place into a contemporary workplace through three key theories: • Landscape –
large-scale spatial gestures reflecting natural landforms and river movement • Flora & Fauna –
colour, texture, pattern and materiality inspired by native ecosystems • People & Their Stories –
abstracted narratives embedded through furnishings, graphics, signage and lighting Across all five
levels, the workplace was designed to create connection, between people, place, and experience,
while supporting a modern, flexible working environment. Materiality, spatial rhythm, and detailing
were carefully considered to create delineation between focus, collaboration and social areas while
maintaining a cohesive identity throughout the tenancy. The result is a workplace that reflects its
environment, responds to its context, and brings storytelling into everyday experience. 🔗Link in
bio to read more Project Manager: @rcp_aus Builder: @fdc_group Client: Undisclosed Services:
@ndygroup Structural: @arupgroup Graphics & Signage: @elevation_design11 ESD: Dsquared Acoustics:
@resonateconsultants Aboriginal Artist: Meiwi Aboriginal Art by Sam Gollan 3D Renders: Pointillism
📸@trimphotography #iadesignaustralia #WorkplaceDesign #InteriorDesign #CommercialDesign #Adelaide
#DesignNarrative #BuiltEnvironment #ArchitectureAndInteriors] ][47]
[ We're proud at IA to introduce our four Graduates. [We're proud at IA to introduce our four
Graduates. Ashley Booth in Sydney, Chris Cauchi in Adelaide, and Poppy Chapman and Tahlia Wilson in

# Grown with love

This small business began as an expression of Mckenzie’s lifelong love of flowers. Growing up in a
home filled with color, fragrance, and seasonal beauty, she came to understand early on how much joy
a hand selected bloom can bring. Today, that love has grown into a near-obsession—with dahlias in
particular. From planting to pruning, to the quiet ritual of harvesting, she finds joy in every part
of the process.

Based in our garden in Sammamish, this endeavor is our way of sharing what we love with others.
Mckenzie is well known for sending friends home with a fresh bundle of flowers, and this business
simply extends that spirit outward. Our hope is that these dahlias offer you the chance to pass
along that same joy, one bouquet at a time.

You can think of an interior designer as a film director. Their job is to monitor every minute
detail from start to the final cut. From pre-production to the final edit, their perspective is
responsible for shaping the final product. Similarly, interior designers are professionals who are
able to gauge your needs and tastes to deliver your dream home. They assist you in getting
custom-designed pieces that fit perfectly into your beautiful vision. From raw materials to finished
products, they take care of everything!

# for Flawless Text & Visuals

Tired of AI tools that mess up your text or layouts? Mew Design turns your words into beautiful,
editable graphics

## Meet Your Meow Designers –
## Purr-fect Creative Partners

Mew.Design is your AI design studio powered by 'Meow Designers'—a team of specialist cats who
transform ideas into visuals. These coded feline agents represent our advanced AI design technology,
each with unique creative superpowers. Brief them just like human designers!

您的浏览器不支持视频播放。

Describe anything and watch your Meow Designer generate options in seconds.

Need changes? Say it in plain English—your AI designer gets it.

Upload images or choose a design from community to learn styles from masterpieces.

Pick or train specialist AI design agents (Meow Designer), like ‘Kawaii Meow’ for cute designs.

Design Freedom for All — Perfected by Adaptive AI
For Everyday Creators
No design skills? No problem! Generate designs in plain English - like 'Create a neighborhood bake
sale poster with cute cupcake drawings' - or browse community creations for inspiration, then
customize with commands like 'make the font playful' or 'use pastel colors'. Done in seconds.
For Professionals
Multiply your creative output with custom AI Design Agents (meet your new ‘Meow Assistants’!). Train
AI agents in your specialty—whether it’s minimalist posters or kawaii banners—to automate repetitive
tasks. Your curated ‘Meow Agents’ learn from your style and execute briefs at scale.
For Brand Teams
Consistency at scale with branded Meow Agents. Deploy company-tailored AI designers that adhere to
your color palettes, fonts, and visual guidelines. Generate on-brand social posts, ads, and
presentations in seconds—like having an in-house designer for every team member. Need a tailored
design agent? Contact us at **admin@mew.design**
Not Just Simpler—Smarter Design
How Mew.Design Outshines Traditional Tools With AI Conversation
[Hot icon]
Much Easier
Ditch the complexity of Adobe/Figma. While Adobe and Figma require months to master, Mew.Design’s
natural language interface lets you create instantly. No layers, no panels—just describe your vision
and get production-ready graphics in seconds.
[Hot icon]
More Creative
Go beyond Canva's templates. While template tools limits you to preset layouts, our AI engine
generates truly unique designs—whether you need a social media post, event poster, or business card.
Start fresh or remix community ideas with commands like ‘make it cyberpunk’.
[Hot icon]
Smarter Text Integration
Precision where AI art tools struggle. While tools like Midjourney often render text unpredictably,
Mew.Design combines AI-generated visuals with intelligent typography—delivering polished posters,
invitations, and flyers with fully editable layouts. Change fonts, adjust spacing, or refine
hierarchies with simple text prompts.

# Big Changes on the Prairie

### Garden Scientists Look to Prairies of the Past to Support Future Conservation


In an effort to ensure a future for one of the most threatened ecosystems in the world, Garden
scientists are looking to the past, using herbarium specimens to study changes in tallgrass prairies
over the last 130 years.

Presented by

[PNC logo]


On view April 10–September 26,* Patterns in Nature: The Art of HYBYCOZO* explores the wondrous
connection between art, science, and nature through 21 intricately designed and interactive
installations located throughout the Garden.

Experience the beauty and mystery of nature's geometry by day, by night, and only at the Garden.

## MINNESOTA FFA

###### Agricultural Education

School-Based Agricultural Education prepares students for successful careers and a lifetime of
informed choices in the global agriculture, food, fiber and natural resources systems.

[ext.jpeg]

###### National FFA Organization

FFA is a national, intra-curricular student organization for those interested in agriculture and
leadership. Per Public Law 116-7,
FFA is one of three components of School-Based A[gricultural Education][40].

[FFA-Day-1000x430.jpg]

###### FFA for All

From the agriculture classroom to the blue jacket, we are dedicated to providing access to and the
experience of premier leadership, personal growth, and career success to all Minnesota youth.

About Us

## Growing Leaders, Building Communities, and Strengthening Agriculture

The FFA experience is valuable to all students, regardless if they do or do not ultimately pursue
agricultural careers. FFA members are both prepared to embark on a career in agriculture through
opportunities available in eight different career pathways, and they are prepared for career success
in another chosen field because the components of the mission become differentiating power skills.
FFA members, regardless of future occupation, become informed and supportive consumers, leaders in
building their communities and help strengthen agriculture.

## VISION

##### Students whose lives are impacted by FFA and agricultural education will achieve academic and
##### personal growth, strengthen American agriculture, and provide leadership to build healthy
##### local communities, a strong nation, and a sustainable world.

## The first instance of sending flowers in Philippines is at the time of birth.

When a child is born in the family, all the family members rejoice the moment with full pomp and
show. Greetings are sent endlessly to the proud parents for their bundle of joy. The grandparents
are on top of the world after the arrival of their grandchild. The relatives shower gifts on the new
born and demand treats and lavish parties from the parents and grandparents. This is the first
instance in his life when delicate posies are sent for him with best wishes and blessings for his
bright future. [Send flowers online to Philippines][232] through our website to celebrate the
marvellous addition in the family. There will be many instances in future when you can send him a
range of baby products and other gifts but at the time of birth, only unadulterated gifts are
suitable for the sensitive baby. Flowers are a part of nature and nothing can be as suitable as the
dainty and delicate posies to the flower that has blossomed in your home. You can easily send
flowers to the Philippines to brighten someone's day with our flower delivery service. While
ordering flower delivery to Philippines online for infants make sure that you give clear
instructions to our team to have the flower arrangement made toxin-free and safe, to be kept in the
proximity of the child. No harmful sprays are used to preserve the flowers as the fumes might harm
the little one. Send beautiful flowers to the Philippines and make your loved ones' day extra
special. The packaging should also be, made infection-free and all possible care should be taken
keeping in mind the sensitive nature of the new born.

## The importance of flowers occurs first in childhood.

Childhood is a phase in which a child is seldom a receiver of flowers. Only on rare occasions, he is
a recipient of flowers, while the majority of the time he is the one who send flowers to
Philippines. While in school the children are taught ways to express their gratitude. Teacher's Day
is one instance on which every child wishes to present flowers and gifts to his tutors. Initially,
it is only to impress and please the teacher but as he grows up he realises that it is a wonderful
way to show his gratitude to the people who prepare him for the journey of life by imparting
knowledge to him. The earlier the children were taken by their parents to the local flower shop in
Philippines but as times have changed now and there is very less time for the parents to spare they
prefer to order flowers online in Philippines for their children to take on Teacher's Day. At first,
glance presenting flowers to the teachers to thank them might seem an insignificant gesture by in
the long run it is very useful because the feeling of gratitude is inculcated in the child at a
tender age and it goes with him throughout his life. He learns to thank people for whatever they
have done for him and he does it really gracefully. Parents also teach their children to wish their
grandparents on their special occasions as it gives them immense joy. The children are too
inexperienced to buy gifts and order [flowers delivery in Philippines][233] by themselves. The
assistance of parents helps them in this situation. This is a great lesson imparted by the parents
to give happiness to the elderly. This also signifies that our elders do not expect lavish gifts and
parties. Only a few posies and a note addressed to them with your love enclosed are enough to
appease them. We offer same-day delivery of flowers in the Philippines, ensuring your messages reach
your loved ones quickly and beautifully. Help your children place orders for online flowers delivery
to Philippines on our website www.myflorista.ph on Teacher's Day, Grandparent's day, anniversaries
and birthdays of grandparents and other relatives too. So when they grow up they will have the
realisation that their parents only need their attention, a little of their time and of course a lot
of unconditional love from them.

## The first instance of sending flowers in Philippines is at the time of birth.

When a child is born in the family, all the family members rejoice the moment with full pomp and
show. Greetings are sent endlessly to the proud parents for their bundle of joy. The grandparents
are on top of the world after the arrival of their grandchild. The relatives shower gifts on the new
born and demand treats and lavish parties from the parents and grandparents. This is the first
instance in his life when delicate posies are sent for him with best wishes and blessings for his
bright future. [Send flowers online to Philippines][232] through our website to celebrate the
marvellous addition in the family. There will be many instances in future when you can send him a
range of baby products and other gifts but at the time of birth, only unadulterated gifts are
suitable for the sensitive baby. Flowers are a part of nature and nothing can be as suitable as the
dainty and delicate posies to the flower that has blossomed in your home. You can easily send
flowers to the Philippines to brighten someone's day with our flower delivery service. While
ordering flower delivery to Philippines online for infants make sure that you give clear
instructions to our team to have the flower arrangement made toxin-free and safe, to be kept in the
proximity of the child. No harmful sprays are used to preserve the flowers as the fumes might harm
the little one. Send beautiful flowers to the Philippines and make your loved ones' day extra
special. The packaging should also be, made infection-free and all possible care should be taken
keeping in mind the sensitive nature of the new born.

## The importance of flowers occurs first in childhood.

Childhood is a phase in which a child is seldom a receiver of flowers. Only on rare occasions, he is
a recipient of flowers, while the majority of the time he is the one who send flowers to
Philippines. While in school the children are taught ways to express their gratitude. Teacher's Day
is one instance on which every child wishes to present flowers and gifts to his tutors. Initially,
it is only to impress and please the teacher but as he grows up he realises that it is a wonderful
way to show his gratitude to the people who prepare him for the journey of life by imparting
knowledge to him. The earlier the children were taken by their parents to the local flower shop in
Philippines but as times have changed now and there is very less time for the parents to spare they
prefer to order flowers online in Philippines for their children to take on Teacher's Day. At first,
glance presenting flowers to the teachers to thank them might seem an insignificant gesture by in
the long run it is very useful because the feeling of gratitude is inculcated in the child at a
tender age and it goes with him throughout his life. He learns to thank people for whatever they
have done for him and he does it really gracefully. Parents also teach their children to wish their
grandparents on their special occasions as it gives them immense joy. The children are too
inexperienced to buy gifts and order [flowers delivery in Philippines][233] by themselves. The
assistance of parents helps them in this situation. This is a great lesson imparted by the parents
to give happiness to the elderly. This also signifies that our elders do not expect lavish gifts and
parties. Only a few posies and a note addressed to them with your love enclosed are enough to
appease them. We offer same-day delivery of flowers in the Philippines, ensuring your messages reach
your loved ones quickly and beautifully. Help your children place orders for online flowers delivery
to Philippines on our website www.myflorista.ph on Teacher's Day, Grandparent's day, anniversaries
and birthdays of grandparents and other relatives too. So when they grow up they will have the
realisation that their parents only need their attention, a little of their time and of course a lot
of unconditional love from them.

## Floral Design

We believe the little things make all the difference between something nice and something
unforgettable. We hold true to our passion of making even the smallest details special and unique.

Floral services range from full service floral and decor design to DIY and a la carte packages.

[Travis and Deb groomsmen.jpg]
[Myriah and John The Wedding-Jiminez Wedding-0953.jpg]
[KateandGregWedding-185.jpg]
[Styled Elopement -082_websize.jpg]


### full service FLORAL - curated DESIGN plan // Starting at $10,000

This service includes decor design planning or collaboration with your wedding planner. From linens
to tableware, vessels, signs and decor, we aim to create one cohesive and signature look that blends
flowers with your design style and color palette.

### FULL SERVICE FLORAL - standard packages // STARTING AT $4500

This service is designed for the client whose florals are inspired by contemporary styles and
current trends. The PacWest Blooms floral team has created price point packages based on guest
counts and covering the standard areas (Personal, Ceremony and Reception) that need flowers. This
package does not include custom or luxe flowers.

For the 2023 Season minimums start at

100+ guests $6,000

50 - 99 guests $4,500

### A LA CARTE // DIY // elopement florals

We have you covered in the areas of personal, ceremony and reception flowers. Your choice of designs
that do not require setup or teardown (such as bride and bridesmaid bouquets, boutonnieres and
corsages, centerpieces, and accent bouquets). For designs that require on-site installation, such as
arch flowers, chandelier and ceiling flowers, floral backdrops, and elevated centerpieces, clients
may choose Full Service Floral Design.

———————-

### pacifica package // Starting at $5200

This package is created for an intimate celebration of 20 guests or less. Beach or courthouse
weddings with dinner at a local restaurant, hotel or private residence are what this package is
curated for and includes event coordination, the couples personal flowers, garden chairs for the
ceremony, reception flowers and 6” ceremonial cake. Please inquire for high level details.

## "We are making it simple,
## but significant"

### -Don Draper 

Hi, I'm Sydney

## Founder + boss babe

A country girl born & raised in Orange County, California. I worked with fresh floral for 5 years,
but decided to launch a business around dried pieces. I knew deep down it would do amazing, back in
2020 dried floral was the new & best thing. Needless to say most of our clients are here now for the
fresh, high quality, lush blooms! I LOVE love which is why I could never leave the wedding industry.
I recently just got married in 2023 & wow does it open up your eye being a bride. I wouldn't want to
do anything else in life but work for our couples & clients! I definitely know the ins and outs of
all things floral & design !

Over the past 23 years we have helped create a smooth experience for hundreds of people just like
you.

Give us a call or send us a message and let us create a joyful experience in fulfilling your floral

# Breathing Life Into Cities

[ Book Your CPD ][59]
[ Our Products & Services ][60]
[our vision]

## Encouraging biodiversity into our built environment

We are an innovation led company that combine planting and technology to bring biodiversity back
into our cities and clean the air.

We use sustainable planting in strategic locations to form biodiversity corridors through our
cities.

Wayfinding and placemaking for our insects and birds, air cleaning for our city dwellers.

As horticulturalists we are proud of our achievements in being globally responsible and helping
fight climate change.

With your help we can make a difference by collaborating, inspiring, and sharing our knowledge and
passion as we breathe life back into cities.

[ Read More ][61]

## Our Products

[
[Living Walls]
][62]

### Living Walls

Living Walls & Green Walls designed, installed and maintained by Scotscape for improved
biodiversity, air quality & to mitigate the urban heat island effect.
[Read more][63]
[
[Living Pillars]
][64]

### Living Pillars

Living Pillar® The NEW Urban Greening innovation from the Scotscape Group.
[Read more][65]
[
[Micro Forests]
][66]

### Micro Forests

The Urban Micro Forest - innovative and effective afforestation for carbon mitigation in urban
areas, delivering exceptional air quality and biodiversity benefits to the built environment.
[Read more][67]
[
[living art]
][68]

### Living Art

LivingArt® , introducing planting to the workspace has a positive impact on wellbeing and
productivity.
[Read more][69]

## Our Services

[
[Landscape Service]
][70]

### Landscape Services

Working in close partnership with landscape architects & garden designers to create & install
beautiful gardens supporting biodiversity & health.
[Read more][71]
[
[landscape maintenance finished works apartment]
][72]

### Landscape Maintenance

Managing and nurturing sustainable landscapes, sharing our passion for Biodiversity and guiding our
clients towards sustainable practices in collaborative working partnerships.
[Read more][73]
[
[Market Place Derby with lighting]
][74]

### Biodiversity Events

Raising awareness of the need for more Biodiversity in our Towns and Cities is very important to us.
To this end we have become involved with a number of public events designed to showcase the
importance of tree planting in the urban environment.
[Read more][75]

Contact us to discuss your project
