# Breathing Life Into Cities

[ Book Your CPD ][59]
[ Our Products & Services ][60]
[our vision]

## Encouraging biodiversity into our built environment

We are an innovation led company that combine planting and technology to bring biodiversity back
into our cities and clean the air.

We use sustainable planting in strategic locations to form biodiversity corridors through our
cities.

Wayfinding and placemaking for our insects and birds, air cleaning for our city dwellers.

As horticulturalists we are proud of our achievements in being globally responsible and helping
fight climate change.

With your help we can make a difference by collaborating, inspiring, and sharing our knowledge and
passion as we breathe life back into cities.

[ Read More ][61]

## Our Products

[
[Living Walls]
][62]

### Living Walls

Living Walls & Green Walls designed, installed and maintained by Scotscape for improved
biodiversity, air quality & to mitigate the urban heat island effect.
[Read more][63]
[
[Living Pillars]
][64]

### Living Pillars

Living Pillar® The NEW Urban Greening innovation from the Scotscape Group.
[Read more][65]
[
[Micro Forests]
][66]

### Micro Forests

The Urban Micro Forest - innovative and effective afforestation for carbon mitigation in urban
areas, delivering exceptional air quality and biodiversity benefits to the built environment.
[Read more][67]
[
[living art]
][68]

### Living Art

LivingArt® , introducing planting to the workspace has a positive impact on wellbeing and
productivity.
[Read more][69]

## Our Services

[
[Landscape Service]
][70]

### Landscape Services

Working in close partnership with landscape architects & garden designers to create & install
beautiful gardens supporting biodiversity & health.
[Read more][71]
[
[landscape maintenance finished works apartment]
][72]

### Landscape Maintenance

Managing and nurturing sustainable landscapes, sharing our passion for Biodiversity and guiding our
clients towards sustainable practices in collaborative working partnerships.
[Read more][73]
[
[Market Place Derby with lighting]
][74]

### Biodiversity Events

Raising awareness of the need for more Biodiversity in our Towns and Cities is very important to us.
To this end we have become involved with a number of public events designed to showcase the
importance of tree planting in the urban environment.
[Read more][75]

green spaces that enhance aesthetics and promote well-being.

maintaining healthy plants through feeding schedules, optimal placement, and selecting the right
plants for each specific area

We convert indoor areas into fully functional indoor farms, offering comprehensive services from
construction to the supply of the desired plants.

[ Read more ][31]

residential and commercial spaces. We offer tailored landscaping services to meet your needs.

[ Read more ][32]

We transform balconies into lush green spaces, creating either forest-like retreats or personal
allotments for growing your own plants and vegetables.

#### Supply and maintain your green friends

tailored maintenance services.

green spaces that enhance aesthetics and promote well-being.

maintaining healthy plants through feeding schedules, optimal placement, and selecting the right
plants for each specific area

[ Read more ][30]

construction to the supply of the desired plants.

[ Read more ][31]

In addition to our other services, we extend conventional landscaping solutions to cater to both
residential and commercial spaces. We offer tailored landscaping services to meet your needs.

[ Read more ][32]

We transform balconies into lush green spaces, creating either forest-like retreats or personal
allotments for growing your own plants and vegetables.

[ Read more ][33]

[Mercantile Market at Three Petals Farm]
Mercantile Market at Three Petals Farm
A local haven for fresh flowers, handmade goods, and everything that makes your day a little
brighter. Come explore seasonal blooms, artisanal treats, and unique finds—all right here on the
farm. Grab a bouquet, browse the market, and soak in the simple joys of community.
[ Learn More ][73]
[Floriculture Collaborative of Southern New Jersey]
Floriculture Collaborative of Southern New Jersey
The Floriculture Collaborative of Southern, NJ - a regional network connecting flower farmers and
florists across Southern New Jersey through weekly coordination, seasonal planning, and local flower
availability sharing.
[ Learn More ][74]
[Our Story...]
Our Story...
Three Petals blossoms from the teamwork of Mallory and Gary Turner—her 15+ years of floral magic
plus his farming roots and military grit. Named after their three daughters, the whole family grows,
designs, and digs in together, creating bright, heartfelt, nature-inspired florals.
[ Read more here ][75]
Love Notes
What Our Customers Say...
The flowers I ordered for my mom were beautiful. She sent me a photo and told me she was very happy
with them. Thank you for making her birthday special!
Lindsay Grant
I ordered flowers for my father's funeral, and Three Petals Farm made the process so easy. They were
very down to earth and understanding. Their friendliness and guidance helped get me through ordering
everything I needed. Thank you.
Emily Hart
I ordered flowers to surprise my girlfriend at work. They made sure to deliver them within her work
hours, and she loved them. Thank you for your help!
Alex Jones
[Directions]
Directions
We offer daily delivery to Millville and surrounding areas. Our studio is by appointment only, but
you can order online daily or stop by our roadside farm stand. We are located outside of Millville
City closer to Lawrence Township on Cedarville Road. Enjoy a quiet trip to our studio outside the
hustle and bustle of the main city.
